title: U-blox Unwraps Pair of Wi-Fi 6 Modules for Cost-Sensitive Designs

body_text: U-blox has introduced the MAYA-W5 and NORA-W5 Wi-Fi 6 module families for industrial and IoT applications, designed and manufactured in Europe.
